prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a torn-paper arrow; a paper chart.
Opens on the sliding panels, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the sliding panels close into a paper chart; a torn-paper arrow cuts down across it and stops low.
Ends holding on the down arrow.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "SHARE PRICE FALL".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "SHARE PRICE FALL". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage shot, photographed flat under soft room light. <Picture 1> serves as the first frame, establishing a deep magenta block-color paper ground that fills the entire frame. At the top, a cream-colored paper chip features the headline "SHIFTING FRAMEWORKS" in bold black sans-serif typography. Below it, two white torn-paper panels with black halftone textures are held apart by two cream-colored paper ribbons. The camera is a Static Shot. Immediately, the "SHIFTING FRAMEWORKS" chip and the two white panels slide rapidly off-frame to the left and right, respectively, with a slight overshoot. Simultaneously, a new cream paper chip with the text "SHARE PRICE FALL" printed in bold black sans-serif, clean and legible, slides in from the top to occupy the upper third of the frame, landing with a firm, stable snap. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, the sliding panels converge and close together to form a single, flat paper chart cutout; this chart is a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout with rough white torn edges, and it is entirely blank with no markings, lines, or numbers. Immediately after the chart settles, a black-and-white halftone torn-paper arrow cutout slices rapidly down across the chart from the top, stopping abruptly in the lower section. Every element—the headline chip, the chart, and the arrow—is made of matte printed paper and casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right, indicating a consistent light source from the upper left. The video ends by holding this final composition of the "SHARE PRICE FALL" headline and the downward arrow over the blank chart, with a subtle, minute rhythmic pulse of the paper elements.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of crisp, tactile foley sounds. There are distinct, light paper-slap sounds as the chips and panels slide and land, accompanied by the short, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down.
